description: This file defines interface declarations, macros, and includes for a DSL hardware abstraction layer within a larger software project. It references external JSON handling libraries and declares several functions related to DSL line statistics and information retrieval.

methods.name: dslhal_getlinestats
methods.description: Retrieves DSL line statistics based on a parameter name and outputs the data to the provided structure.

methods.name: dslhal_getXRdk_Nlm
methods.description: Obtains RDK NLM information for a given parameter name.

methods.name: dslhal_getlineinfo
methods.description: Fetches DSL line information and fills the provided structure.

methods.name: xtm_hal_getLinkStats
methods.description: Retrieves link statistics related to XTM (Ethernet over ATM) interface.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_dslGetChannelInfo
methods.description: Gets detailed channel information for a given parameter.

methods.name: xdsl_hal_dslGetChannelStats
methods.description: Retrieves channel statistics for DSL channels.
